WITH line_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(cost) as total_cost,
    COUNT(*) as expense_count
  FROM expense
  GROUP BY link_to_budget
),
average_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_cost) as avg_total
  FROM line_totals
)
SELECT 
  AVG(lt.total_cost) as average_of_totals,
  SUM(lt.expense_count) as total_expenses,
  AVG(lt.total_cost - at.avg_total) as avg_excess
FROM line_totals lt
CROSS JOIN average_total at
WHERE lt.total_cost > at.avg_total

assumptions.assumption: All expenses have a non-NULL link_to_budget value. Budget lines without any expenses are implicitly excluded from the analysis.
'Above that average' is interpreted as strictly greater than (>), not ≥. If ties should be included, change WHERE to >=.
